name: keeping the personnel register
from: Who holds what office known only by asking, or by reading prose that may or may not still be true, with incumbency untracked as the double settlement it actually is.
to: A register in which incumbency, the three rights, and mutual selection are readouts — settled facts a session can check rather than a claim it must trust.
cost: Tracking a settlement (recognition and induction) that prose has never had to distinguish, and recording the three rights honestly enough to show when a unit has been given two of them and told it has all three.
otherwise: Who holds an office is exactly as reliable as the last session's memory of it, which is how a person got recorded as First Officer without ever having held the role.
